description: Masteries represent the pinnacle of your character's specialization, embodying unique combat styles, strategic advantages, or thematic identities. Each Mastery is a culmination of skills and experiences that set your character apart as a true legend in their field. You can only have one Mastery at a time, making it a defining aspect of your character's identity and playstyle.
selection_advice: When selecting a Mastery, consider your character's background, playstyle, and the narrative you want to create. Each Mastery offers unique abilities and thematic depth, allowing you to craft a character that stands out in the world of Sellswords.
limit: Your character can acquire up to a maximum of one (1) mastery at any time.
pro_tip: Masteries are your ‘end-game’ achievements. So, it’s best to choose one early on so that you can prepare for it by building your character based on its prerequisites.
note_on_achievements: Before gaining access to any Mastery, you must first complete all listed Achievements in addition to meeting the standard prerequisites. While some Achievements have clear, objective requirements, others may require interpretation. For any Achievement that seems ambiguous or open-ended, collaborate with your Director to establish specific criteria and determine when you've successfully completed it.
